title: Stop the newsroom machinery competing with stories on the home page
description: On the home page, accepted findings, suggested findings and conversations compete with published articles. The review calls these two audience experiences: reading a publication, and inspecting how it's made. Propose a clearer hierarchy that keeps both. Ryan previously asked for three blocks of six with bands, so bring him a mock-up in the preview first.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Done on develop. Stories keep two rows; accepted and suggested findings show one row each. Order and bands unchanged. Not released.
